setting: You are all dog walkers who meet at the park in Brisbane, where you have walked clients' dogs side by side for a while. You use this group chat to swap pickup times and cover for each other when someone is stuck. This week you are sorting out who takes which dogs over the summer heat, and who is doing the early starts.

text: Suggest we swap friday walks? I've got physio at 9 and the 7am lot is what's pulling me out of bed anyone up for taking mine
I can do 7 fri I finish late thurs so I'll be a bit wrecked but yeah
Yeah the 6 at the creek. Not doing the 5:30 that's a no
Morning. What's the forecast today, I'm seeing 34 by 11
35 at the airport apparently. Keep them off the concrete and do the shaded loop first
Will do. Biscuit won't go past the bridge anyway
Hot already. Dog at the creek wouldn't drink from the bowl, had to pour it in his mouth 😂
Can someone cover my 3pm thurs? Vet thing for the lab, she's been off since last night
I can do 3 if you're ok with me getting there at 3:15. Bit of a wait at physio first
Perfect that works. Thanks. I owe you a coffee
Just finished at the cafe. Boss asked me to do the 5am bakery run tomorrow too so my early start is double
That's brutal. Still on for fri 7 then?
Yeah I'll do it. But if I'm not up by 6:40 someone text me. Don't trust myself
Can't sleep. The fan's just moving hot air around
